profile:
### Rock Candy (Aqua Crystal Foal) — G4

**Who she is:** A pale mint-green Crystal Empire Earth-pony filly with a magenta-pink mane and tail and warm orange eyes. Look for her among the youngsters admiring Spike in *The Crystalling – Part 1*.

**Names:** **Rock Candy** is a background-character/fandom catalog name, not a name spoken in the cartoon. The licensed Gameloft *My Little Pony* mobile game identifies the same filly as **Aqua Crystal Foal** (introduced with its Crystal Empire update in September 2016). The precise origin of the Rock Candy nickname is unverified; these are two names for the same character, not an alternate identity.

**Appearances:** Background appearances in *The Crystalling – Part 1* (S6E1, Spike's fan crowd) and *The Beginning of the End – Part 1* (S9E1). In the mobile game she belongs to the *Spike's Biggest Fans* collection and lives in the Twin Crystal Home alongside Chiffon Crystal Foal.

**Speaking:** No distinct spoken line or named voice actor can reliably be assigned to Rock Candy. The season-six transcript attributes the two featured fangirl lines to Cloudy Spinel and Coral Shores and has a group 'Awwww!' from the foals; credits include a generic “Foal” (Nicole Oliver) but do not establish that it is Rock Candy.

**Show still:** [![Rock Candy identification still from The Crystalling – Part 1](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/mlp/images/9/9d/Rock_Candy_ID_S6E1.png/revision/latest?cb=20160328184304)](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/File%3ARock_Candy_ID_S6E1.png)

*Image attribution:* Still from *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic* (Hasbro/DHX); indexed by the My Little Pony Friendship is Magic Wiki. Original screencap uploader is unverified; this is not independently authored fan artwork.
